name: attention
description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin whose two Claude lifecycle-hook sensors feed allowlisted runtime-owned executors (ADR-0044 §2 and ADR-0045 §2, as reduced by ADR-0064): context.mjs publish-session for session capture at Stop, and context.mjs entry-brief for the SessionStart entry line (two capability floors that never share a constant, declared in data/runtime-floors.json). Hooks + sensor scripts only: no skills, no verbs, no state machinery. The plugin contributes zero plugin-owned Codex hook surface: the Codex manifest declares no hooks AND the Claude registration is manifest-scoped at adapters/claude/hooks/hooks.json, deliberately outside Codex's default-file discovery (host truth: Codex 0.144.1 loads a root hooks/hooks.json regardless of command shape — ADR-0040 §3 amendment). The ADR-0044 capture firing point and the ADR-0045 entry hook surface are Claude-only at v1 (ADR-0044 §8 / ADR-0045 §10 — Codex gets the symmetric CLI + dashboard surfaces).

interface.shortDescription: Claude lifecycle hook sensors that feed the runtime's session-capture publisher and entry-brief arbiter (turn-end capture + session-entry brief)
interface.longDescription: Hook-only Layer 1 plugin per ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2 and ADR-0045 §2 into host-lifecycle sensors feeding allowlisted runtime-owned executors, and reduced by ADR-0064 to those two — the hook-bearing sibling of the ADR-0008 script-only library shape. On Claude Code it registers Stop (the session-capture spawn — context.mjs publish-session with fixed argv --repo-root, --host claude, a clamped optional --session-id, and --workflow-evidence fresh only when a freshness-checked last-session-handoff.json projection proves a terminal persona workflow per ADR-0043 §3) and SessionStart (explicit startup matcher with an explicit 15 s per-hook timeout: spawns the runtime entry-brief arbiter — context.mjs entry-brief with fixed argv --host claude --surface session-start-hook — through a stdout-capturing dispatcher whose validation boundary relays at most one marker-paired brief line into model context: bounded buffer, successful child exit, exactly one marker-paired line, no extra output, byte cap, malformed/oversized suppression; the scoped ADR-0045 §2.2 sensor-output exception, while the Stop sensor stays stdout-silent). Each sensor resolves the newest installed runtime by manifest identity through a copied discover-runtime ladder (env override → this host's install cache → the other host's cache → sibling checkout), then gates that one root on its own capability floor — publish-session >= 0.82.0 (the first release shipping the publisher, per session-capture-contract §13) and entry-brief >= 0.83.0 (the first release shipping the entry arbiter, per §18), declared byte-for-byte in data/runtime-floors.json and never sharing a constant. Below its own floor — or when the floor passes but the executor file is absent (capability drift) — each spawn skips silently while the other keeps working, never re-descending to an older cached build. Sensors are fail-closed observers: exit 0 always, no Stop decision output, no structured hook responses; a missing or too-old runtime is a silent no-op. Capture stays off until session_capture is opted in (default off, evaluated publisher-side), and the entry line until the user-scope-only entry_brief key is set (default off, evaluated arbiter-side), both via runtime:settings. The plugin exposes no plugin-owned hook surface to Codex: this manifest declares no hooks and no functional skills (the skills/ directory is the Codex manifest-spec placeholder per the ADR-0008 carve-out), and the Claude registration lives at the manifest-scoped adapters/claude/hooks/hooks.json — deliberately outside Codex's default-file discovery, which host truth (Codex 0.144.1) showed loads a root hooks/hooks.json regardless of command shape (ADR-0040 §3 amendment). The ADR-0044 capture firing point and the ADR-0045 entry hook surface are Claude-only at v1 (ADR-0044 §8 / ADR-0045 §10 — Codex gets the symmetric CLI + dashboard surfaces).
